banner.title: Timalemekeza zinsinsi zanu
banner.text: Timagwiritsa ntchito ma cookie ndi umisiri wofanana. Ma cookie ofunikira amathandiza kuti tsambali ligwire ntchito. Mukatilola, timagwiritsanso ntchito ma cookie osankha pa zinthu zina, kusanthula ndi kutsatsa malonda. Mukhoza kuvomereza zonse, kukana zonse, kapena kusankha gulu lililonse, ndipo mukhoza kusintha maganizo anu nthawi iliyonse.

preferences.title: Zokonda pa ma cookie
preferences.text: Sankhani magulu osankha omwe mukuwalola. Ma cookie ofunikira sangazimitsidwe chifukwa tsambali siligwira ntchito popanda iwo.

necessary.title: Ofunikira
necessary.description: Amafunika pa ntchito zoyambira monga chitetezo, kugawa katundu ndi kukumbukira kusankha kumeneku.

functional.title: Ogwira ntchito
functional.description: Amakumbukira zokonda monga chilankhulo kapena dera ndipo amathandiza zinthu zophatikizidwa kugwira ntchito.

analytics.title: Kusanthula
analytics.description: Amatithandiza kumvetsa momwe tsambali limagwiritsidwira ntchito kuti tiliwongolere.

marketing.title: Kutsatsa
marketing.description: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito poyeza ndi kusintha zotsatsa malinga ndi munthu pa mawebusayiti osiyanasiyana.
